articles.content: Eine Studie, veröffentlicht im Fachmagazin Nature, hat ergeben, dass die Impfung gegen Gürtelrose-Viren das Risiko einer Demenzerkrankung um 20 Prozent senken kann. Dieser Effekt wurde bei Seniorinnen und Senioren unter 80 Jahren beobachtet, die eine kostenlose Gürtelrose-Impfung erhalten hatten. Forscher wie Konstantin Sparrer vom Deutschen Zentrum für Neurodegenerative Erkrankungen in Ulm gehen davon aus, dass jegliche Virusinfektion das Risiko einer Demenzerkrankung erhöhen kann, und daher eine Impfung, die vor einer Infektion schützt, auch vor Demenz schützen könnte.
articles.title: What is happening in Alzheimer's research.

articles.content: A forest restructuring effort can be economically viable despite initial costs and reduced revenues from activities like hunting leases or timber sales, as it enhances the stability of the forest ecosystem. This approach requires increased personnel and expenditure but ultimately yields long-term benefits. The German television program Plusminus reported on this topic on September 3, 2025.
articles.title: Why a forest restructuring is worthwhile.

articles.content: Researchers have discovered that octopuses have a preferred tentacle, with some arms being used more frequently for specific tasks than others. This finding could significantly advance the field of soft robotics due to the unique characteristics of octopuses, including their flexible and strong arms. The intelligent behavior of octopuses is made possible by their highly developed nervous system, which is distinct from that of vertebrates.
articles.title: Octopuses have favorite arms.
